responsibility: Implements the central language-independent diagnostics controller, diagnostics::context. This file owns context initialization and teardown state, default printers and sinks, diagnostic counting and option classification setup, column and source-printing defaults, extra-output and escape-format policy, and many of the shared helpers used when reporting diagnostics, formatting locations, managing fix-it change sets, buffering, and coordinating sink output; it is the main execution core of the diagnostics subsystem rather than a format-specific sink or a single feature helper.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for diagnostics::context and related policies: it defines initialization, runtime behavior, helper routines, and context-specific selftests, and wires the context to sinks, file caching, buffering, and fix-it output. In contrast, context.h declares the context object layout and policy/helper class interfaces.
